en: Abu Marwan Abd al-Malik ibn Zuhr
ar: أبو مروان عبد الملك بن زهر

description.tr: Perikard apselerini ilk tanımlayan, ilaçları insanlardan önce hayvanlarda test eden, trakeotomiye öncülük eden ve iç dikişlerde kedigüt kullanan kişi || İbn Zühr, ilaçları insanlara vermeden önce sistematik olarak hayvanlarda test ederek deneysel farmakolojiye öncülük etti. || [Tarih notu] Colin'in 1911 çalışması İbn Zühr'ün deneysel farmakolojideki önceliğini belirledi.
description.en: First to describe pericardial abscesses, first to test medicines on animals before humans, pioneered tracheotomy and used catgut for internal sutures. His Taysir complemented Ibn Rushd's theoretical Kulliyat || Ibn Zuhr pioneered experimental pharmacology by systematically testing medicines on animals before administering them to humans — a practice not standardized in Europe until the 19th century. His Taysir was deliberately written as the practical companion to Ibn Rushd's theoretical Kulliyat, forming a complete medical system. He described laryngeal treatment and demonstrated that surgical incisions in the larynx could heal. || [Historiographical note] Colin's 1911 study established Ibn Zuhr's priority in experimental pharmacology. The Taysir-Kulliyat partnership with Ibn Rushd is unique in medieval medical literature.
description.ar: أول من وصف خراجات التامور وأول من اختبر الأدوية على الحيوانات || ريادة ابن زهر في الصيدلة التجريبية باختبار الأدوية على الحيوانات قبل البشر — لم تُقنن في أوروبا حتى القرن التاسع عشر. التيسير مع كليات ابن رشد شكّلا نظامًا طبيًا كاملًا
